note: Where product feedback goes. A mailto address, nothing more: the page itself never sends anything, so the on-device claim and invariant 11 are untouched. Set on the owner's instruction to a personal inbox. This sits on a public page, so treat it as permanently scrapeable, and expect distress mail alongside product notes: the `feedback.notSupport` copy is what stands between a person in difficulty and an email nobody reads tonight. Swapping in a forwarding alias later is a one-line change here and nowhere else. While `address` is null the section hides itself, so an unset value ships safely. `formEnabled` turns on the in-page form, which POSTs to the same-origin /api/feedback relay. Leave it false until FEEDBACK_RELAY_TOKEN, FEEDBACK_TO and FEEDBACK_FROM are set in the Vercel project, otherwise the form renders and every submission returns 503. The relay forwards to an inbox and stores nothing, so there is no retention policy to write and nothing to delete on request.
subject: Reitti preview — a note
because: The preview exists to be argued with, and the people best placed to argue with it are clinicians and county staff who have no other way to reach us. A link that costs nothing to ship is worth more than a feedback form that would put a server between a person and their own answers.
